text: Our work on reverse proxy weaknesses has been accepted to NDSS 2027. Congratulations, Tianhao!
Our work on internationalized PKI was invited for presentation at IETF 125 in Shenzhen.
Our work RebirthDay was selected by the Black Hat Asia 2026 Review Board as one of the Top 5 Must-See Research Presentations
Our paper about code signing abuse was presented at NDSS 2026.
Our paper about domain registries' operation issues was presented at USENIX Security 2025.
Our work about cross-origin web attacks was invited for presentation at Black Hat USA 2025.
